title: Heuristics for the Direct Aperture Optimisation in Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy: A Systematic Literature Review
core_idea: Perform a systematic literature review of heuristic algorithms addressing the direct aperture optimisation (DAO) problem in intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT), tracing their development and application over the past two decades by synthesising relevant studies.
tldr: A systematic review that collects and synthesises 41 studies (2002–2023) from seven major databases on heuristic methods for the DAO problem in IMRT, with the goal of mapping developments and informing researchers and practitioners.
